1000:61f3.name: InitializeDosRuntime
1000:61f3.plate_comment: Recovered MZ external entry: relative CS:IP=0000:61f3, analysis load segment=1000. Initializes DS to 1676, establishes stack, resizes DOS allocation, parses environment/command line, clears BSS, then calls RunGameSessionLoop. The original DIET stub was independently emulated to this instruction; all 30076 initialized module bytes matched. Decompiler stack recovery remains incomplete; this is not recovered source.

1000:01b8.name: RunGameSessionLoop
1000:01b8.plate_comment: High-confidence orchestration function: VGA/EGA detection, timer/resource initialization, menu/selection flow, road loading, repeated RunRoadSession calls and completion bookkeeping. Mode values and all global types remain provisional.

1000:0069.name: AbortOnResourceError
1000:0069.plate_comment: Checks DS:41aa error state. Restores text mode/handlers and prints 'Not enough memory' for code 8, otherwise 'Error loading data files'; then terminates. DS:41aa semantics inferred from DOS wrapper writes.

1000:00bb.name: LoadTrekDataArchive
1000:00bb.plate_comment: Opens filename at DS:0cfc ('trekdat.lzs'). Initializes buffered input, reads two little-endian words per record, allocates record storage, writes size difference, and calls DecodeLzsBlock. Ends on shared input/error state; exact record semantics and EOF treatment are not yet reconstructed.

1000:5614.name: LoadRoadByIndex
1000:5614.plate_comment: Opens DS:0e08 ('roads.lzs'). Seeks index*4, reads uint16 file offset and uint16 decoded length, then seeks to block. Reads 3 uint16 metadata fields into DS:4562/54a2/4566; copies 216 bytes to DS:41c2, then decodes length bytes into far pointer DS:162c. Clears 7000-byte destination first; returns decoded_length/14. Metadata field meanings and tile bit layout remain unverified.

1000:2b3d.name: RunRoadSession
1000:2b3d.plate_comment: Sets up road presentation, calls RunGameplayLoop, and on result 0 displays 'Road completed' or 'The End', selected by caller argument. Restores session resources and returns gameplay result.

1000:1fd9.name: RunGameplayLoop
1000:1fd9.plate_comment: Provisional semantic name, supported by repeated tick-synchronized input/render/update loop, collision-style helper calls, movement arithmetic and exit reasons. Returns 7 on tested key flag; exact controls, physics units, and global meanings need tracing. Contains significant decompiler uncertainty.

1000:3acc.name: InstallTimerHandlers
1000:3acc.plate_comment: Replaces real-mode interrupt vectors 08h (linear20h) and24h (linear90h), retains old08h vector, programs PIT ports43h/40h with divisor19e4h and speaker channel42h with divisor0002h. Hardware behavior not executed.

1000:5c77.name: OpenFileReadOnly
1000:5c77.plate_comment: DOS open wrapper: loads filename argument into DX and AX=3d00h, then calls shared INT21/error wrapper. ABI/return signature not fully recovered.

1000:5c59.name: CloseFileHandle
1000:5c59.plate_comment: DOS INT21 AH=3eh close wrapper; skips close when DS:41aa equals15h. Handle is a near-stack argument at SP+2, loaded into BX. Current decompiler signature omits that argument.

1000:5c82.name: PrintConsoleString
1000:5c82.plate_comment: Walks NUL-terminated string and calls WriteConsoleCharacter. Uses DS-relative near pointer.

1000:5fd4.name: WriteConsoleCharacter
1000:5fd4.plate_comment: DOS INT21 AH=02h, DL=character. Emits carriage return before newline (LF) to produce CRLF.

1000:6027.name: ProbeEgaSupport
1000:6027.plate_comment: BIOS INT10 AH=12h BL=10h; returns true if BL was changed and is at least3. Name describes use as fallback EGA support check; hardware behavior not exercised.

1000:603b.name: ProbeVgaSupport
1000:603b.plate_comment: BIOS INT10 AX=1a00h; requires returned AL=1ah and BL in[7,8], the VGA display-combination codes. Hardware behavior not exercised.

1000:6420.name: InitializeBufferedInput
1000:6420.plate_comment: Stores input handle at DS:41ac, prepares buffer via63f0, refills via6364, resets bitreader/EOF flags. Used by archive and road loading.

1000:6576.name: ReadBufferedWordLE
1000:6576.plate_comment: Calls ReadBufferedByte twice and combines first byte as low8bits, second as high8bits.

1000:6490.name: ReadBufferedByte
1000:6490.plate_comment: Reads current buffered byte from DS:41b0 then advances/refills using6326. Current return type is broader than meaningful low8bits.

1000:64ab.name: ReadBufferedBitMSB
1000:64ab.plate_comment: Returns highest bit of current byte, shifts left, decrements remaining count DS:41ae and loads next byte when count reaches0.

1000:64ff.name: ReadBufferedBitsMSB
1000:64ff.plate_comment: Consumes requested number of MSB-first bits, accumulates result in AX. Current decompiler incorrectly infers void return; register semantics verified in raw instructions. Do not treat current prototype as recovered ABI.

1000:66e6.name: DecodeLzsBlock
1000:66e6.plate_comment: Shared decoder for .LZS resources. Raw stack ABI: far destination at BP+4, uint16 output length at BP+8. Reads3 control bytes and patches instruction immediates at CS:6729,671f,674c and6751 (self-modifying decoder). Selects literal bytes or overlapping backreferences using MSB-first bit input; ends at output bound and aligns input. Label is based on resource filenames and algorithm shape; no exact external LZ variant or full decoder replay has been verified. Ghidra parameters shown in pseudocode are unreliable.

1000:6679.name: AlignBufferedInputToByte
1000:6679.plate_comment: If remaining bit count is not8, consumes that count through ReadBufferedBitsMSB. Used after decoded blocks.
